abstract: OBJECTIVE: Several growth factors and cytokines appear to participate in the proliferation or differentiation of trophoblast cells. The purpose of this study was to investigate the extent to which keratinocyte growth factor participates in the development of human embryonic and trophoblast cells at the maternal-fetal interface. STUDY DESIGN: The reverse transcriptase-polymerase chain reaction method was used to determine the gene expression of keratinocyte growth factor and keratinocyte growth factor receptor in human choriocarcinoma cells (BeWo), human teratocarcinoma cells (PA-1), and human endometrial stromal cells. We also examined the effects of keratinocyte growth factor on cell proliferation and production of human chorionic gonadotropin in BeWo and PA-1 cells. RESULTS: Keratinocyte growth factor gene was expressed in all cell types. The expression was pronounced in stromal cells of the endometrium collected during the secretory phase and early pregnancy. The keratinocyte growth factor expression was also enhanced in the differentiated BeWo cells. The expression of keratinocyte growth factor receptor gene was observed only in the BeWo cells. The addition of keratinocyte growth factor to the medium did not affect cell proliferation of the BeWo and PA-1 cells. On the other hand, keratinocyte growth factor (100 ng/mL) significantly enhanced human chorionic gonadotropin production in the BeWo cells. Stimulatory action of keratinocyte growth factor on human chorionic gonadotropin production in the BeWo cells was markedly enhanced after forskolin-induced differentiation. CONCLUSIONS: We conclude that keratinocyte growth factor may play an important role in promotion of human chorionic gonadotropin production in the trophoblast cells.
abstract_ja: 目的：ケラチノサイト増殖因子(KGF)が、ヒト胚細胞および栄養膜細胞の発生に関与する程度を、母体と胎児の境界面で検討すること。研究デザイン：逆転写酵素ポリメラーゼ連鎖反応(RT-PCR)法を用い、ヒト絨毛癌細胞(BeWo)、ヒト奇形癌細胞(PA-1)、ヒト子宮内膜間質細胞におけるKGFとKGF受容体の遺伝子発現を測定した。また、BeWo細胞とPA-1細胞において、KGFが細胞増殖およびヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)産生に及ぼす影響を検討した。結果：KGF遺伝子はすべての細胞型で発現していた。発現は分泌期および妊娠初期の子宮内膜間質細胞で顕著であった。BeWo細胞の分化によりKGF発現は増強された。KGF受容体遺伝子はBeWo細胞でのみ観察された。培地へのKGF添加はBeWo細胞およびPA-1細胞の増殖に影響しなかった。一方、KGF(100ng/mL)はBeWo細胞のhCG産生を有意に増強した。KGFによるBeWo細胞のhCG産生促進作用は、フォルスコリン誘導分化後にさらに増強された。結論：KGFは栄養膜細胞におけるhCG産生の促進に重要な役割を果たす可能性がある。
